evidence.detail:
Nick chose high trust and included K18 in the three reference products. This is practical calibration, not newly established scientific certainty.

A small ex-vivo study examines a listed K18 mask formula. The inspected text does not clearly describe its tensile-strength gain as significant; without a suitable control, the peptide's contribution is not isolated.

Abbey Yung's original video is recorded as a routine lead, but her exact experience was not verified. Missing access is not negative evidence.

Restorative treatment with initial and maintenance phases; not a potency ranking.

Historical v0.3 evidence observations (owner grades and selected Redken source now follow the later owner decision):

N06 confirms that only No.0's tensile-strength increase is explicitly significant. K18 surface/appearance changes are observed, but K18 spectral changes are largely attributed to excipients and do not establish protein reconstruction.

E05/N06 describe the same small study, not two independent experiments: three heavily bleached Caucasian tresses per condition, 10% product/hair mass, single four-minute treatment, nonstandard dose/handling and no vehicle/conditioner comparator.

E04 generic peptide binding on glass arrays does not establish exact-mask efficacy. N09 routine metadata supplies no inspected first-person experience verdict.

E05 and N06 are one paper with improved endpoint description; neither fibre counts nor repeated text imply independent studies.

N06 states university authors, ERDF/POCI, Amyris Bio Products Portugal and university support, with no competing interests declared. E04 funding/COI is not independently audited.

N09 is an original-video lead whose description includes K18; no outcome, duration or creator endorsement is extracted from inaccessible content.

Target is the DE source variant; global fragrance additions and catalog binding remain separate. No molecular reconstruction or rank versus No.0 is claimed.

limitations: N06 confirms that only No.0's tensile-strength increase is explicitly significant. K18 surface/appearance changes are observed, but K18 spectral changes are largely attributed to excipients and do not establish protein reconstruction.

Unavailable creator videos are leads only; absent access is neutral, not evidence of no effect.

applicability.bridge: Martins et al. 2024 list K18's 21-ingredient formula and four-ingredient OLAPLEX No.0. Twice-bleached purchased Caucasian tresses: 10% product/hair mass, one-minute massage, four-minute reaction, brushing, 48-hour conditioning; three tresses per condition, mechanical testing on 25 fibres. Reported tensile improvement is clearly significant for No.0; K18's reported increase is not clearly significant in the inspected text. Multiple surface/structural measurements are reported.

full institutional PDF; methods/results/funding inspected; no numerical chart inference

Eine kleine Ex-vivo-Studie untersucht eine gelistete K18-Maskenformel. Der geprüfte Text stellt den Zugewinn an Zugfestigkeit nicht klar als signifikant dar; ohne passende Kontrolle ist eine Wirkung allein des Peptids nicht isoliert.
